1. Data Storage
• Google Sign-In: Your expenses, monthly budgets, wallets, and savings goals are stored securely in your private cloud account (Firebase Firestore) and are accessible only by you.
• Guest Mode: All financial records stay strictly on your device until you choose to sync with Google or delete them.

2. Camera, Photos & AI Processing
• When you scan a receipt or ask SakuPintar AI, only the image or financial summary needed for that request is sent to generate your expense extraction or insight.
• We never sell your personal or financial data to third parties.

3. Security & Your Control
• App Lock PINs are hashed locally using salted SHA-256 and never leave your device.
• You can export your data anytime or permanently erase all your records from Settings > Delete Account.

1. Purpose of App
SakuPintar is a personal finance tracking and budgeting companion designed to help you log daily expenses, monitor wallets, and plan savings goals.

2. AI Insights Disclaimer
Automated receipt scanning, budget recommendations, and SakuPintar AI chat responses are provided for informational convenience only and do not constitute licensed financial, tax, or investment advice. Always verify scanned receipt totals before saving.

3. User Responsibility
You are responsible for keeping your device and Google account credentials secure. You may export or permanently delete your data at any time through the Settings screen.
